topic_queues.text: Visitors to the Chinese capital usually spend their first morning in long queues at the Wenhua Palace Museum.

topic_season.text: Many travellers say that late autumn is the most pleasant season for a trip to northern China.

topic_hotels.text: Hotel prices in the Chinese capital rise sharply during the Spring Festival holidays.

best_subway.text: The best thing about the Beijing subway is that trains on the Line 30 arrive every two minutes.

best_greenway.text: Local cyclists agree that the best thing Beijing has ever built is the Wenhe Greenway along the canal.

best_taxi.text: The best thing that happened to Beijing taxi drivers last year was a new fare system.

close_walk.text: Many residents of Beijing take a walk in the evening after dinner.

close_coffee.text: In Beijing, small coffee shops are usually full of students in the evening.

close_parks.text: Office workers in Beijing often stroll through quiet city parks after a long day.
